subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which compatibility contract should OpenClaw use for Feishu `--bind` values before any candidate PR lands?
rationale: The current public CLI contract treats two-segment binds as account selection, while the reported Feishu group flow needs a peer binding; changing that contract can affect existing account-scoped setups and competing PRs propose different syntax choices.

options.title: Preserve account binds and add explicit peer support
options.body: Keep documented `channel:account` and channel-only behavior intact, then add a clear peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu recognition with docs and regression tests.

options.title: Adopt Feishu two-segment peer inference
options.body: Allow Feishu-looking values to become peers, but require an explicit account escape, upgrade notes, and proof that account-scoped setups remain expressible.

options.title: Pause this branch for a sibling candidate
options.body: Pick another open candidate if it better matches the desired grammar, then close remaining candidates only after one viable fix merges.

recommendation.title: Preserve account binds and add explicit peer support
recommendation.body: Keep documented `channel:account` and channel-only behavior intact, then add a clear peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu recognition with docs and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The compatibility question centers on the account-scoped bind command surface introduced in PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/27195.
